name: Type reflection member queries require the reflection subsystem

input.fixture_ref: Inspect kind, arguments, members, subtype?, and assignable? on normalized String | Integer and A & (B | C) Type objects.

applicability.reason: Requires a Type query namespace. No such namespace exists at all: Type.kind, Type.members, Type.subtype? and Type.assignable? each answer NameError, and Reflection::Type is an UnsupportedConstruct. An earlier reason said Type.kind was implemented; it is not.

expect.status: Reflection reports canonical normalized identity and exposes all mandatory Type query surfaces.
